test_captured_output: test the pybind11 captured output functions that redirect C++ stdout to Python stdout
test_captured_utf8: test the pybind11 captured output with multi-byte UTF-8 characters across buffer boundaries
test_ostream_redirect: test the pybind11 ostream_redirect context manager to capture C++ stdout and stderr in Python
test_captured_err: test the pybind11 captured error output that redirects C++ stderr to Python stderr
test_threading: test the pybind11 ostream_redirect thread safety by spawning multiple C++ threads with redirected output
